reason: short answer over the limits after one retry

text: FAA guidance: If the control link is lost, reestablish the link or start emergency procedures; if VLOS cannot be regained, follow loss-of-control procedures, with the remote PIC maintaining responsibility for safe operation. Manuals: If RTH is triggered and the aircraft is <20 m from the Home Point, it will land automatically; if >20 m, it ascends to the pre-set RTH attitude and then flies to the Home Point, planning a return route or retracing the original flight path. Incident reports (unverified): RTH did not engage when activated, and RTH via a slave controller reportedly failed.
